integrity.computational_dependency: numpy and scipy for optional finite verification

limitations: Canonical unweighted Euclidean graphical zonotopes \(K_p\) join an independent q-set, integer \(p\ge3\) and \(q\ge2\). The q-asymptotic is for p fixed; p-coefficient limit is iterated, not a joint p,q limit. No independent historical-priority or mathematical audit. May be equivalent to an unindexed earlier result.
title: Surface-area condensation and a Poisson-edge constant for complete-split graphical zonotopes
